title: The Bin multi-select limits the table to parts stocked in those bins
preconds:
1. You are on the Parts Velocity report with data loaded.
2. Inventory parts are stocked in at least two different bin locations..
steps:
1. Open the Bin filter and select one bin location.
2. Add a second bin location.
expected:
1. Each selection reloads the data from the server.
2. Only inventory parts stocked in ANY of the selected bins are shown.
3. The filter allows more than one bin (multi-select).

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Parts Velocity report specification version 11 (S2-R8), read on 17 August 2026.
Last checked against build v3.8-d0e135e on 8/19/2026.
Re-checked against the live specification on 26 August 2026: the requirements this case cites are unchanged, so only the version cited above was updated.
